# commander_classic_payment_card (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Keeper `bankCard` (Payment Card) record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a payment card record by title or UID.
data "commander_classic_payment_card" "example" {
  bank_card = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_TITLE_OR_UID_"
}

output "payment_card_id" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.id
}

output "payment_card_title" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.title
}

output "payment_card_notes" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.notes
}

output "payment_card_folder_location" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.folder_location
}

output "payment_card_details" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.payment_card
  sensitive = true
}

output "payment_card_cardholder_name" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.cardholder_name
}

output "payment_card_pin_code" {
  value     = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.pin_code
  sensitive = true
}

output "payment_card_address_ref" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.address_ref
}

output "payment_card_custom" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.custom
}

output "payment_card_share" {
  value = data.commander_classic_payment_card.example.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bank_card` (String) Payment Card record **title** or **UID** to look up.

### Read-Only

- `address_ref` (String) **UID** of a linked record.
- `cardholder_name` (String) **Cardholder name**.
- `custom` (Attributes List) Custom fields stored in the record's `custom` array. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom))
- `folder_location` (String) Folder `path` or `UID` where the record is to be stored.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier (UID) of the vault record.
- `notes` (String) Note of the record.
- `payment_card` (Attributes) Payment card details (`paymentCard` field). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--payment_card))
- `pin_code` (String, Sensitive) **PIN code**.
- `share` (Attributes Map) Mapping of share permissions for this record. Each map **key** is a **user email**; each **value** is an object with `can_share` and `can_edit` booleans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--share))
- `title` (String) Record title.

<a id="nestedatt--custom"></a>
### Nested Schema for `custom`

Read-Only:

- `label` (String) Field label.
- `sensitive` (Boolean) Whether the value should be treated as **sensitive**.
- `type` (String) Keeper field **type** (e.g. `text`, `email`, `secret`).
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Field **value** (JSON-encoded for complex types).


<a id="nestedatt--payment_card"></a>
### Nested Schema for `payment_card`

Read-Only:

- `card_expiration_date` (String) Expiration `MM/YYYY`.
- `card_number` (String, Sensitive) **Card number**.
- `card_security_code` (String, Sensitive) **Security code**.


<a id="nestedatt--share"></a>
### Nested Schema for `share`

Read-Only:

- `can_edit` (Boolean) Allow the user to edit this record. Defaults to `false`.
- `can_share` (Boolean) Allow the user to re-share this record with other users. Defaults to `false`.
